content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I believe the latest [product_name] version has been released. I have the most recent [product_name] software, but the hardware selection menu does not show the FS5 version. Can someone assist?
The newer [product_name] versions, including FS05 and FS06, as well as the latest FS01, should be chosen in the hardware selection menu as [product_name] FS4.
Hi, The FS05 version of [product_name] was launched on 1 September 2017 together with [product_name] software version 8.1.1 (SP1). Which software version are you using?

@[user_name], [product_name] with firmware versions 05 or 06 belong to the 8.1 series. The latest [product_name], the 8.2 series with FS01 (which I own), is also listed under FS04 in the hardware selection. No newer models than FS04 appear in the hardware selection of [product_name] software version 8.2.
Hello [user_name], has your issue been resolved?
Yes, @[user_name]. Thank you for the information.
A new question by [user_name] was moved to a separate thread regarding modifying the logic so the Hours counter value starts from zero. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty selecting the correct hardware module version in the [product_name] software. The hardware menu does not list newer FS numbers directly, so all versions must be chosen under FS04. This creates confusion about matching physical hardware with software and leads to questions about compatibility and features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] software to clearly list newly released hardware versions in the selection menu, making it easy to find and select the version matching their physical device.
